name: orava
description: Orava – a money coach for S-mobiili (Junction 2026). npm workspaces: apps/web, apps/server, packages/core, packages/contracts.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @orava/core && npm run build -w @orava/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @orava/web && npm run build -w @orava/server
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -n core,contracts "npm run dev -w @orava/core" "npm run dev -w @orava/contracts"
scripts.web: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n packages,web "npm:dev:packages" "npm run web -w @orava/web"
scripts.start: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n packages,web "npm:dev:packages" "npm run start -w @orava/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n packages,server "npm:dev:packages" "npm run dev -w @orava/server"
scripts.docker:server: docker build -f apps/server/Dockerfile -t orava-server . && docker run --rm --env-file apps/server/.env -p 8080:8080 orava-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
